posts.headline: Eleven straight editions of dead air and One Nut Barner STILL hasn't said a word before Week 1 kicks off for real.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra owns a 20-8 record and a 1.5 average finish — the best résumé in the building — yet zero rings and zero trash talk, which is its own kind of arrogance.

posts.headline: Sasinci can rebrand nothing else — Big Head's title banner now has to survive actual football, not just a preseason bit.
posts.detail: A 13-15 career record with one championship means Megamind has been coasting on one good year, and this league is done letting him hide behind it.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh drafted a new team and it changes nothing — the untalented tenth still owns the single worst résumé in Busters Anonymous history heading into Week 1.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish don't get erased by a fresh roster; Chauncey has to actually win a game first.

posts.headline: The Clown Show kept its name and its middling identity, and the Alaskan Bull Worm needs Week 1 to finally look like more than a delusional Packers fan cosplaying as an athlete.
posts.detail: A 15-13 career record and a 4th-place average finish is fine — but fine doesn't match the swagger btkempski walks around with.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy Way or the Hard Way opens real Week 1 still stuck with a rookie 6-8 record and a dead-last 10th-place finish — Auntie Thomas hasn't earned a shred of optimism yet.
posts.detail: With no titles and the franchise's only season ending in the basement, this year's fresh roster needs to prove it wasn't just more of the same before the games even count.
